text:
Companion of today, I want

no truth other than yours, to live

where your eyes grow,

giving your light, your channel

to what I see and feel...


Undo that dark skein

of fear,

find what was lost,

break the voice of sleep...


And slowly, slowly

learn to live,

again, again,

as on a morning

loaded with wealth.

translation.title: Companion of Today
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the intimate address as a patient relearning of life.
